desc: Implement forced-array construction with conflict detection (O(n*m)); return "" on conflict.
Implement per-F-window last-free-position computation; validate fully-forced F windows differ from str2 (else "").
Implement greedy fill: forced chars used directly; free chars pick smallest letter not forbidden by any F window whose last free position is p (rest-of-window match check, O(m) each with early exit).

Test against the three examples plus edge cases: m=1 (F forced/free), all-T overlapping conflicts, F window with forced suffix, str2 of repeated chars, n=1, doomed-window subtlety (forced suffix completing a match).
